text.p: Destron Fearing Corp said Wednesday it has reached an agreement with its bank for a restructuring and temporary extension of its bank credit line.
The company also said it has raised $2 million in new capital in a private placement.

The company sold one million shares of common stock at $2 per share to three foreign institutional investors, the company, which makes electronic and visual identification devices for companion animals, livestock, laboratory animals, fish and wildlife, said.

"This restores our working capital to a satisfactory level," said Randolph Geissler, president and chief executive. "With completion of this financing, we will be able to concentrate our efforts on increasing the sales of our electronic identification devices, where we continue to believe that the prospects are currently very bright."
Shares were down 1/2 at three Wednesday.
